title: The Loop
_comment: Protagonist cast for the roguelike 'The Loop' — a lone, mobility-first sword-wanderer in light leather. Sourced entirely from the MODERN Universal-LPC generator (split-per-animation art) so it can carry the expanded platformer poses (jump, climb, run) the classic combined set lacks. Every layer is fetched on demand and composited in z-order; nothing is vendored.
